observations: Dispatch's subscribers list (internal/dispatch/api/subscribers.go:123) shows a subscriber that is no longer live with last_seen = the interest row's updated_at. With the unchanged-row skip that time can be up to 5 minutes before the session's last heartbeat. Live subscribers read the session row, which is still written on every heartbeat. The listener's AGENTS.md table now says the stored subscription's updated_at is its last change or refresh; Dispatch's view does not say so.
